notes: Defunct brand kept as its own file: per the page, BDP Company was created by Carrier in 1974 uniting Bryant, Day & Night, and Payne, and BDP as a stand-alone brand/company is no longer in use circa 2006-2009 (Day & Night revived under ICP circa 2006; Bryant and Payne remain under Carrier). Styles are transcribed from the BDP page's own full text rules, not borrowed via usesStylesOf: the BDP page states every position rule and the Style 5 letter-year table in text, and its example serials match Bryant's system shape-for-shape. Single-digit years in styles 3, 3-Canada, and 4 are encoded as digit-keyed letterTable maps because the schema digits kind does not support 1-character year slices; the mappings are fully documented on the page, and the Style 3/4 eras (1980-1984, 1970-1979) bound them as the single-digit-year policy requires. Style 5 week/year table is stated in full text on the page (L 1960 through H 1979, skipping O, Q, Z).

styles.era: 10-character format, week-year in first four digits
styles.notes: Page example shown as '07 09G10932'; normalized it is 0709G10932. Week is 1st-2nd positions, year is 3rd-4th positions.
Page example shown as '85 0304091'; normalized it is 850304091. Year is 1st-2nd positions, month is 3rd-4th positions.

Page example shown as 'W 4D14008'; normalized it is W4D14008. Month letter is 1st position, M-Z skipping O and U for January-December. Year digit is 2nd position, 0-4 for 1980-1984. Year uses a digit-keyed table because the schema digits kind cannot express a 1-character year.

Page example shown as '4 WD14008'; normalized it is 4WD14008. Canadian variant only: year digit is 1st position, month letter is 2nd position, same tables as US style 3. Split from style 3 because one style cannot carry two position assignments.

Page example shown as 'A 167890'; normalized it is A167890. Month letter is 1st position, A-L with no letters skipped. Year digit is 2nd position, 0-9 for 1970-1979. Year uses a digit-keyed table because the schema digits kind cannot express a 1-character year.

Page example shown as '46 U152456'; normalized it is 46U152456. Year letter begins with L for 1960 and cycles to H for 1979, skipping O, Q, and Z. Week is the 1st-2nd positions; the page states this example is the 46th week of 1967. Split from the one-digit-week variant because fixed position ranges cannot express both.
Page example shown as '2 W13270'; normalized it is 2W13270. Same year-letter table as style 5a. Week is the 1st position only; the page states this example is the 2nd week of 1969.
